messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — trying to finish onboarding `nebula-v2` today. I pushed weights to s3 but CI flags a couple of issues. Anyone able to triage?

tony: pinging infra — which s3 path? permissions?

maria: s3://redwood-weights/nebula/nebula-v2/2026-03-16/ (object names: model.pt, model.index, tokenizer.json)

priya: I see the objects but CI log shows `Tokenizer mismatch: vocab_size 50257 != config.vocab_size 50256`. Looks like a stray special token in tokenizer.json.

oliver: that often happens when we add a <tool> token during preprocessing. Can you paste tokenizer snippet?

maria: ```json
{"special_tokens":{"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","additional_special_tokens":["<tool_call>"]},"vocab_size":50257}
```

priya: yep — config.json expects 50256. Either remove `<tool_call>` from tokenizer or bump config.vocab_size. Which is preferred?

maria: prefer adding token, we need tool_call support. But want to avoid re-quantizing weights. Any config validation quirks?

tony: config bump is safest if the underlying tokenizer files are authoritative. But watch for embedding layer size mismatch. If we change vocab_size, model's embedding matrix rows must match. Check model.index metadata for vocab dims.

eng-ci-bot: CI report: 
- model.meta.vocab_rows: 50256
- tokenizer.vocab_size: 50257
- status: FAIL (vocab_size mismatch)

priya: Maria — easiest path: update model metadata to 50257 if embedding matrix already has extra row. If not, regenerate tokenizer without extra token and add the tool token at runtime via special_tokens_map in serving config.

maria: Can someone run a quick check on embedding rows? I'm on call until 11.

oliver: running `python -c "import torch; m=torch.load('s3://redwood-weights/.../model.pt', map_location='cpu'); print(m['model']['tok_embed.weight'].shape)"` now — output: `(50257, 2048)`

priya: OK that means weights match tokenizer. So update config.json to 50257. Also need to add schema entry in serving config: `tokenizer_extra_tokens: ["<tool_call>"]`.

maria: done. pushed config.json -> s3 path and triggered config-lint.

eng-ci-bot: lint results: 
- config schema: OK
- quant_profile: WARNING (no quant_profile provided for ampere)
- rollout_policy: OK

tony: Quant profile warning not blocking but flagging for infra. @sre-liz can you advise on auto-quant recommendations for this family (nebula)? :eyes:

sre-liz: For ampere/gpu-pool-3 we prefer q4_0 for latency-sensitive services, but for dedicated workloads q8_0 can be more stable. Add `quant_profile: q4_0` to dedicated config if you expect low-latency.

maria: noted, will add. One more — golden prompt suite returned a structured output regression on `tool_call` detection. The eval harness says function call field missing for one case.

priya: which test? paste the example.

maria: test name `golden/toolcall/exec-steps-12.json` — expected: `{ "tool_call": {"name":"run_shell","args":...} }` but got plain text instruction.

oliver: Could be tokenizer splitting `<tool_call>` differently causing prompt truncation. Try re-running the golden with `max_input_length: 2048` and with prefix caching disabled.

maria: reran with those flags — two failures remain. Attaching diff in thread: missing function signature in one output.

priya: possible cause: model version mismatch — some endpoints hit a fallback variant without tool-calling head. Confirmed?

eng-ci-bot: routing table snapshot: 
- nebula-v2@prod -> nebula-v2:1.0.0 (primary)
- fallback -> nebula-v2-lite:0.9.3 (no tool_call integration)

maria: ah — a small percent of requests may route to lite during rollout. For this test we must force routing. Can someone run the eval pointing to model_id=nebula-v2:1.0.0?

tony: started run `./tools/run_eval --model nebula-v2:1.0.0 --suite golden/toolcall` — ETA ~6m.

oliver: quick CR ping @priya — I opened a tiny config-only PR to bump vocab_size and add quant_profile. Needs review to unblock rollout.

priya: reviewing now. A couple minor comments, but LGTM. Please squash commits.

sre-liz: eval finished?

eng-ci-bot: eval results: 98/100 pass. Failures: 2 (both previously caused by routing to lite). When forced to 1.0.0, both pass.

maria: great — merging config PR, will start canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

tony: when you start canary, please add a short smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"nebula-v2:1.0.0","input":"run ls"}' | jq .` and check `tool_call` field exists.

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone :tada:

oliver: noted for postmortem: add a small checklist for tokenizer+config parity and routing pin in eval harness.

priya: also add a note in the onboarding docs: "If you add special tokens for tool calling, verify embedding matrix rows and config.vocab_size are consistent".

maria: adding docs update now and will follow up with rollout status later.
